findings.summary: CSV support removed from SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES, UI, and all tests, but MIME_TYPES_SUPPORTED in GeminiExtractor still maps 'text/csv' to Kind.DOCUMENT; unit test and paid integration test for CSV were both removed, leaving no regression coverage for the still-functional extractor code path.
findings.failure_scenario: An existing CSV document in the database gets extracted via ExtractorRunner -> GeminiExtractor._extract -> _get_kind_from_mime_type('text/csv'), which still returns Kind.DOCUMENT. If a Gemini API model update later breaks or changes CSV extraction behavior, no existing test will catch it because test_get_kind_from_mime_type no longer parametrizes 'text/csv' and test_extract_csv was deleted entirely.
